name: Contribution of the EDPB to the European Commission’s evaluation of the Data Protection Law Enforcement Directive (‘‘LED’’) under Article 62 LED
property_summary: EDPB contribution to the European Commission’s evaluation of the Law Enforcement Directive (LED) under Article 62. It concerns law-enforcement data protection law rather than general private-sector GDPR guidance.
property_reason: This is a general regulatory contribution on the LED with only indirect impact on the bank, unless it directly affects law-enforcement data sharing or cooperation.
